extension.name: pyrig command protection
extension.description: Reviews pyrig project initialization, synchronization, scratch execution, scaffolding, cache deletion, and integration removal. Covers direct pyrig entrypoints and uv run pyrig, not arbitrary project CLIs, plugin commands, or other launchers. Help and version do not match operation rules; independent Guard requirements still apply. Based on pyrig 18.99.1; installed plugins and overrides can change behavior.
safer_alternatives: Review command help and source before execution.
Back up the project and review generated diffs before committing.
Inspect .scratch.py and imported modules before executing project code.

permissions.label: Initialize a pyrig project
permissions.description: Deletes existing removable managed configuration, synchronizes the project, initializes Git, stages files, and creates an initial commit. The existing-commit check does not protect uncommitted configuration.
safer_guidance: Use a new disposable directory or back up existing configuration before initialization.

permissions.label: Synchronize pyrig-managed files
permissions.description: Creates or updates managed configuration and mirrored tests, importing source modules during test discovery. Without paths it reconciles the whole project. A nonzero exit can indicate applied changes rather than a failed operation.
safer_guidance: Review project modules and configuration overrides, back up changes, and inspect the diff after synchronization.

permissions.label: Execute pyrig scratch code
permissions.description: Runs the project-root .scratch.py as __main__, executing arbitrary project-local Python code.
safer_guidance: Read .scratch.py and its imports before execution; use an isolated environment for untrusted code.

permissions.label: Scaffold pyrig CLI source
permissions.description: Appends a CLI stub to the project command module, or to shared_subcommands.py with --shared. Shared commands can be discovered by other pyrig-runtime CLIs in the environment.
safer_guidance: Check the command name and target module, and review the generated source before use.

permissions.label: Create pyrig package initialization files
permissions.description: Creates missing __init__.py files under the project's source and test package roots.
safer_guidance: Check the source and test roots and review newly created initialization files.

permissions.label: Import and scaffold a pyrig subclass
permissions.description: Selects or imports a class's module and appends a subclass skeleton to project source. Explicit module references may execute import-time code.
safer_guidance: Verify the selected module is trusted and inspect the generated subclass before use.

permissions.label: Remove pyrig bytecode caches
permissions.description: Recursively removes __pycache__ directories under the source and test package roots.
safer_guidance: Verify the source and test package roots before cache cleanup.

permissions.label: Remove pyrig hooks and dependencies
permissions.description: Removes pyrig-managed version-control hook entries and removes pyrig and its dependent plugins from the development dependency group. Previously generated files remain.
safer_guidance: Back up hook and dependency configuration and review the removal diff before committing.

rules.title: pyrig project initialization
rules.description: Reviews removal of managed configuration and initial project/Git setup.
safer_alternatives: Back up existing files or initialize in a new directory.

rules.title: pyrig project synchronization
rules.description: Reviews managed file updates and source imports for mirrored tests.
safer_alternatives: Review imported modules and back up changes before synchronization.

rules.title: pyrig command scaffolding
rules.description: Reviews writes to project and shared CLI modules.
safer_alternatives: Review the target module and generated source.

rules.title: pyrig initialization file creation
rules.description: Reviews creation of missing source/test __init__.py files.
safer_alternatives: Review newly generated files before committing.

rules.title: pyrig subclass scaffolding
rules.description: Reviews module imports and subclass source writes.
safer_alternatives: Trust the selected module and inspect generated source.

rules.title: pyrig bytecode cache removal
rules.description: Reviews recursive deletion of source/test bytecode caches.
safer_alternatives: Verify project source/test roots before cleanup.

rules.title: pyrig integration removal
rules.description: Reviews hook and development dependency removal.
safer_alternatives: Back up hook/dependency configuration before removal.
